thought.text: Heap tuned, daemon and emulator stopped (RAM now free). Rebuilding:

reasoning_content:
- Gradle daemon was killed (by PID)
- gradle.properties: currently 3G heap, 1G metaspace
- Emulator was killed by the earlier shell's `adb emu kill` (before the shell died — the device list is now empty)
- RAM has been freed up

Re-running the build (no emulator this time, full RAM available):
